summary.text: Justin Sanchez represents the 17th District on the New York City Council, which includes Mott Haven, Melrose, Morrisania, Longwood, Hunts Point and Crotona Park East in the South Bronx.
His Council biography describes a career as a Council community liaison, a Bronx Borough President's office staffer and chief of staff to Assembly Member and later state Senator Nathalia Fernandez.

paragraphs.text: Sanchez was raised by a single teenage mother and grandparents who were first-generation Americans, according to his Council biography.

He graduated from the Bronx High School of Science, where he interned with a state Senator, and later served as a Community Liaison in the City Council and in the administration of Bronx Borough President Rubén Díaz Jr.
He was Chief of Staff to Assembly Member Nathalia Fernandez and continued in that role after she was elected to the State Senate.
He has served as Director of Latino Outreach for the New York State Democratic Party and as president of the Stonewall Democratic Club of New York City.
He was valedictorian at the CUNY School of Labor and Urban Studies, holds a Master of Public Administration from New York University, and attends Fordham University School of Law.
